subject: I wasn't going to send this to you
preview_text: There's someone specific in your life who needs SoulPlan. You already know who. Here's why.
body_paragraphs: Remember that time you told me your relationship was getting stale? You downloaded SoulPlan, and suddenly date night became something you actually looked forward to again. That's not luck—that's a system.

But here's the thing: there's someone in your life right now who's stuck in the same rut you were in. Maybe it's your brother who keeps complaining his girlfriend feels forgotten. Or your best friend who's been canceling plans because their partner is always too tired for the same old dinner-and-a-movie routine. You know exactly who I'm talking about.

SoulPlan's referral feature lets you send a free week of date ideas to that person—no strings attached. Just one tap in the app, and they get access to AI-generated surprises, budget-friendly options, and the same spark-boosting magic that worked for you. Think of it as paying it forward, but with more romance.

Open SoulPlan now, go to your profile, and tap 'Share the Spark.' Send it to the one person who needs it most. P.S. When they thank you for saving their date nights, you can tell them you got the idea from a secret email—just don't tell them which one.
